metadata.case_name: CHAN YI-KEUNG v. CHU JAU-CHOY AND ANOTHER

source: He had fractures of 8th, 9th and 10th ribs and of the 11th thoracix vetebra and suffered from a crushed spinal cord resulting in total paralysis and loss of feeling from the waist down.

injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of lumbar spinal cord

manifestations.description: total paralysis and loss of feeling from the waist down
permanently confined to bed or a wheel chair
cannot dress, bathe or clean himself
will always have to wear a urine bag and has no control over bladder or bowel function
will probably suffer urinary infections and chest infections

treatments_received: He was in hospital for 10 months
help currently provided by his wife
will always have to wear a urine bag
medical appliances necessitated by his condition have been agreed at $200 per month
treatments_future: professional help of the kind required would probably be unobtainable and if obtainable be most expensive

losses.description: total paralysis and loss of feeling from the waist down
cannot dress, bathe or clean himself; will need constant attention

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: cannot dress, bathe or clean himself
is permanently unfit for any work; hitherto he has been a lorry driver
has lost his normal expectation of life of say 22 years (he is now 46) and has an expectation of about 15 years
